Live staging logs show: POST https://edmskamnzcqswxayuqgd.supabase.co/rest/v1/audit_events -> 404, with app-level CRITICAL log 'audit_log: MANDATORY audit event admin.user_suspend_attempted could not be persisted: {message: function digest(text, unknown) does not exist, code: 42883}'. Root cause (not fixed in this pass, out of scope for the two HIGH findings): core.audit_events_set_integrity() (the audit hash-chain trigger) calls pgcrypto's digest(), but its SET search_path TO 'core', 'public', 'pg_temp' doesn't include the schema pgcrypto's functions actually live in on this Supabase project (typically 'extensions'), so the mandatory-audit-before-destructive-op guard correctly refuses (fails closed, safe) rather than proceeding without an audit trail. This blocks suspend/delete-request/delete-execute entirely on both staging and (presumably, unverified) production until the trigger's search_path is corrected — recommend a follow-up ticket, out of this task's scope.
